polityNote: Republic of Zimbabwe from independence on 1980-04-18 (Rhodesia / Zimbabwe Rhodesia before; outside scope).

sources.title: Wikipedia: Provinces of Zimbabwe, rev. 1326976713
sources.says: Mashonaland North and South reorganised into three provinces in the 1980s (Central and West 1983); Bulawayo and Harare created in 1997.

sources.title: Statoids: Provinces of Zimbabwe (G. Law)
sources.says: 1969 seven provinces with areas differing from today's; ~1981 Mashonaland split into three, Zvishavane area to Midlands; ~1997 Bulawayo and Harare split off.

spans.dateNote: Span begins with the 1997 creation of the metropolitan provinces (year precision; day and instrument not found). Earlier lines differ (see unresolved). No later change recorded.
